# Machine Learning Systems on One Machine

> Find where time and memory go on one machine, fix the largest cost first, and prove each speed-up kept its quality. SDAIA Academy course AE-206, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 19,921 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Measure first](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day1.md): Where time goes, measured before anything is changed; sessions: Compute, memory and bandwidth, Timers, profilers and noise, Profiling a training step, Fixing an input-bound pipeline; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day1.html; about 5,313 tokens
- [Day 2: Memory and training efficiency](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day2.md): Memory first, then the three ways to train faster in it; sessions: Where memory goes, Mixed precision, Accumulation and checkpointing, Compilation and fusion; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day2.html; about 4,272 tokens
- [Day 3: Inference and compression](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day3.md): Serving one prediction fast, then making the model smaller; sessions: Latency, throughput and batching, Language model inference on a laptop, Quantisation, Pruning or a smaller model; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day3.html; about 4,378 tokens
- [Day 4: Export and benchmark](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day4.md): A portable file, an honest benchmark, quality that survives, a choice; sessions: Export to a portable runtime, A benchmark you can trust, Quality must survive, Budgets and trade-offs; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/day4.html; about 4,348 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: an optimisation study and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/capstone.md): Eight minutes of results, a live re-run, four minutes of questions; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/slides/capstone.html; about 990 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Two layers on the roofline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D1_1_roofline.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Noise in one inference](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D1_2_timing_noise.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Profile Lina's training step](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D1_3_profile_step.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Fix the input pipeline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D1_4_input_pipeline.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Memory at three batch sizes](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D2_1_memory_budget.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Reduced precision](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D2_2_mixed_precision.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: A large batch in fixed memory](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D2_3_accumulate_checkpoint.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Compile and fuse](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D2_4_compile_fusion.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Batch size against latency](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D3_1_batching.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Hasad on a laptop](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D3_2_lm_inference.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Quantise Waraqa and Hasad](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D3_3_quantisation.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Prune or shrink](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D3_4_pruning.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Export and check parity](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D4_1_export_parity.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: A benchmark you can trust](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D4_2_benchmark.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Quality by crop type](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D4_3_quality_by_crop.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Choose under the budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-206/labs/D4_4_budget_choice.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
